name: G9 T3 W03 Part 1 - Spot online dangers
description: Spot online dangers. 2 words. Required: Flashcards and Matching. Read the Spark with the same name. Use this part in its Technology class.

words.definition: A trick that uses a fake message to steal private information.
words.example: A phishing message asks for a password on a fake login page.

words.definition: Software made to harm a computer or steal information.
words.example: The malware damages files after an unsafe download.
